_about: By hand: which of her backgrounds an upcoming event brings back (event id from data/go/upcoming.json -> background id in special-backgrounds.json or events.json), and `pokemon`: every Pokémon the event says can get it (names as Leek Duck writes them; 'Toxtricity (Low Key Form)' for a form). tools/build.py adds them and their evolutions to that background, so a returning background never misses the event's new ones (her note, 16 Nov: Feebas from Dynamax Trails was missing). `unsure` stays off the site.

dynamax-trails-2026.unsure: Serebii's event page shows the Dark Skies card; Jemma got a Feebas with it (16 Nov). Leek Duck: any Max Battle catch during the event (every Pokémon that has been in Max Battles, legendaries aside, its Wild Encounters list), and the GO Pass Dynamax encounters. Mawile from Serebii's Max Battle list.

november-communityday2026.unsure: Serebii's Community Day page (19 Nov): Event Exclusive Special Backgrounds, eligible Pokémon Pawniard; the official news says each 2026 Community Day's featured Pokémon can have the yearly background. Wild, research or lure catches not spelled out.
